item.title: I am sometimes overwhelmed by feelings of nostalgia. Is this a bad thing? | Leading questions
item.summary: There’s a difference between longing for the past and assuming it was better, writes advice columnist Eleanor Gordon-Smith . The trick is knowing which you’re feeling Read more Leading questions Is nostalgia a negative emotion? I often feel nostalgic these days. It is a background noise that I am trying to ignore. It was especially present during the pandemic, when my nostalgia seemed to spread into a species of grief for lost places and activities. I find myself thinking sadly about places I won’t be able to visit for a very long time. Continue reading...
